title: Wife Daniella and Uncle Lionel Batiste's funeral
summary: Player met his wife Daniella in Switzerland; her photos of Lionel Batiste's second line funeral outside their house.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: The gumbo, exactly. You just take it and mix it all up and make something new, and that’s how we get where we are. But it’s very interesting. And I just say to everybody, come to New Orleans. Come to New Orleans and experience it. My wife, Daniella, I met her in Switzerland, and it’s like — you know I often think about that, God, I love her, you know, cause man I don’t know how much longer she can stay. Hopefully she’ll stay. She’s been dropped out from the Swiss Alps.
Right. The Super Bowl in New Orleans. Yeah.
Talk about a change in elevation.

Exactly. Exactly. But she gets it though. She gets it. You know what I mean? Like she’s been there and experiences that she’s had, it doesn’t mean that she loves home any less, obviously, but I mean she loves New Orleans, I know that. And she loves living in the Treme. And she can walk out, she took some of the photos, those were her photos that were run yesterday, and I think she had one of, you know we just had this gentleman, © Fillius Jazz Archive -11-

Uncle Lionel Batiste was a Grand Marshall and a bass drum for the Treme Brass Band. And you know, when he passed away, I don’t know, it was like two weeks that parades went on, because so many people knew him all around the world. I mean they had this funeral, they did a second line, and that huge mass of people that were coming down the street on her photo was in front of our house. It was like opening the door and taking a shot of people. The second line, you know, for his funeral. And again, it’s like I’m sitting here and I’m trying to explain this, but I always feel the same thing, like I’m trying to explain it but I really can’t explain this to people. You know you have to come and experience this for yourself.
